description: This file defines the ExternalMessageBuilder interface, which provides methods for constructing ExternalMessage instances with various configurations such as headers, payloads, authorization, enforcement, source, and other metadata.

classes.name: ExternalMessageBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building ExternalMessage objects with various configuration options.

methods.name: withAdditionalHeaders
methods.description: Adds a single header key-value pair to the builder.

methods.name: withAdditionalHeaders
methods.description: Adds multiple headers to the builder.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the message, replacing existing headers.

methods.name: withText
methods.description: Sets a text payload and payload type to TEXT.

methods.name: withBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array payload and payload type to BYTES.

methods.name: withBytes
methods.description: Sets a ByteBuffer payload and payload type to BYTES.

methods.name: withTextAndBytes
methods.description: Sets both text and byte array payloads, payload type to TEXT_AND_BYTES.

methods.name: withTextAndBytes
methods.description: Sets both text and ByteBuffer payloads, payload type to TEXT_AND_BYTES.

methods.name: withAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Associates an AuthorizationContext with the message.

methods.name: withTopicPath
methods.description: Associates a TopicPath with the message.

methods.name: withEnforcement
methods.description: Associates Enforcement data with the message; null disables enforcement.

methods.name: withHeaderMapping
methods.description: Associates HeaderMapping data with the message; null disables header mapping.

methods.name: withSourceAddress
methods.description: Adds the source address where the message was received.

methods.name: withSource
methods.description: Adds the source object where the message was received.

methods.name: asResponse
methods.description: Marks the message as a response message.

methods.name: asError
methods.description: Marks the message as an error message.

methods.name: withInternalHeaders
methods.description: Attaches internal headers for error generation.

methods.name: withPayloadMapping
methods.description: Defines payload mappings for the message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the ExternalMessage instance.
